events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: The original iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, the original iPod dropped. Remember the click wheel? The pure white headphones? The sheer joy of having 1,000 songs in your pocket? A true game-changer.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the cars and, of course, those iconic theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Fawlty Towers,' his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The White Album's 58th Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, 'The Beatles' (also known as 'The White Album'), was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A truly diverse collection – what's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and showmanship continue to captivate millions. The ultimate performer.

events.title: Rubber Soul's 61st Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a pivotal album, showcasing their evolving sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon, in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since his passing. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The influential musician and cultural icon David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Remembering David Bowie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator whose artistry continues to resonate across generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Remembering Elvis Presley
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking and captivating audiences worldwide. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The charismatic frontman of Madness, bringing us joy and 'Our House' for decades.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals gave us some unforgettable 80s classics. What's your favourite?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and icon Dolly Parton was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton! A true superstar, songwriter, and philanthropist. Here's to more years of her shining bright.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow was born on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, his songwriting talent is undeniable.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! His smooth voice gave us some of the biggest hits of the 80s. What's your favourite to dance to?
